svg.aria-label: The tile of row 2 with slots 0, 1, 10 and 11 marked as never written. Thread 0 should sum 85 + 4 times 85 + 6 times 85 + 4 times 85 + 170 = 1,445; with 0 in slots 0 and 1 it sums 1,020. Below, the blurred image computed this way, with the 30 wrong pixels outlined in red, all in columns 0, 1, 6 and 7; pixel (0, 3) is 71 instead of 101.
